name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei
original_name: ひぐらしのなく頃に命
source:
Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Mei is a Higurashi When They Cry mobile game spinoff developed by Smileaxe and originally published by D-Techno.

June 1993, ten years after the "Great Hinamizawa Disaster" in 1983, in which about 1200 residents lost their lives due to released volcanic poisonous gas.

A girl who lost her family to the disaster, Kazuho Kimiyoshi, visits her abandoned hometown of Hinamizawa. But what stood in front of her were monsters she had never seen before. Kazuho desperately runs away. And at that time when she was forced into the predicament of despair, the mysterious existence "Tamurahime" appears and calls herself a god.

Kazuho, who obtained the power to fight "Tsukuyami" from her, is guided into the ritual tool shed in Furude Shrine. After entering the shrine, Kazuho came out to Hinamizawa at a time of peace.

[From [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Higurashi_no_Naku_Koro_ni_Mei]07th Expansion Wiki[/url]]
translation:
《寒蝉鸣泣之时命》是《寒蝉鸣泣之时》的手机游戏衍生作，由Smileaxe开发，最初由D-Techno发行。

1993年6月，距离1983年火山性毒气泄漏、导致约1200名居民丧生的“雏见泽大灾害”，已过去十年。

在灾害中失去家人的少女公由一穗，回到了沦为废墟的故乡雏见泽。然而，挡在她面前的，却是从未见过的怪物。一穗拼命逃跑，就在陷入绝望的危急时刻，一位自称神明的神秘存在“田村媛命”出现了。

从她那里获得了对抗“Tsukuyami”的力量后，一穗受到指引，走进古手神社的祭具殿。然而，走出来时，眼前竟是昔日和平的雏见泽。

[摘自[url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Higurashi_no_Naku_Koro_ni_Mei]07th Expansion Wiki[/url]]
